sa.question: Find total surface area of toy: cylinder r = 3.5 cm, h = 10 cm surmounted by hemisphere of same radius.
sa.model_answer: CSA cylinder + CSA hemisphere + base = 2πrh + 2πr² + πr² = 2πr(h + 2r).

sa.question: Hollow cylinder: outer r = 5 cm, inner r = 3 cm, h = 14 cm. Find volume of material.

la.question: Metallic sphere of radius 4.2 cm melted into cylinder of radius 6 cm. Find height of cylinder.
Frustum bucket: top r = 14 cm, bottom r = 7 cm, h = 30 cm. Find capacity.
la.model_answer: V = (1/3)πh(r₁² + r₁r₂ + r₂²) with given radii and h.
